amendment: A36 rule 5 as amended by A37
statistics: effect sizes with 95% percentile day-cluster bootstrap intervals (2,000 resamples, seed 513); no p-value, no fold test, no Holm (A36 5g)
models: frozen at 5.12 and loaded, sha256 checked against the freeze (A37); nothing fitted on the evaluation path

thresholds.note: the frozen feature threshold is the one used; the baseline threshold was set by A11 on TRAIN at the freeze (A37 1b)

H1b.definition: mean QLIKE(baseline) - mean QLIKE(features), common decision bars; clusters = sessions

H1c.definition: hit rate(features) - hit rate(baseline) in [release, release + 60 min]; clusters = events
